text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to escort you to the training 
grounds, Excellency Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The "fabled water cradled by the sacred 
peak" you requested has been procured, 
Your Excellency Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
But, my feelings are... RESTLESS. Even if 
it is My birthday— being treated like this 
is——

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... As my usually loyal knight— does 
being waited on make you feel a bit 
ticklish?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
However, today is the dawn of your special 
day! Please permit me to repay the 
devotion you bestow upon me every single 
day—!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, today Kris is the guest of honor! 
Now then, what is your wish after 
training? Just say the word♪"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Understood, Lord Kris S. Allow me to 
prepare a towel of the most exquisite 
texture for you♪

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
With great pleasure, Lord Kris S. I, 
Gimlet, shall pour all my soul into 
concocting the finest sustenance to 
nourish your flesh.
